newsitem.title: USA: CBOE to list options on Quest Diagnostics.
newsitem.headline: CBOE to list options on Quest Diagnostics.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said Wednesday it would trade options on Quest Diagnostics Inc shares beginning January 22.
The exchange said the options would have introductory expirations in February, March, May and August, with opening strike prices of 15, 17-1/2 and 20.
The stock was down 5/8 at 17-1/8 late morning Wednesday.
The CBOE said Quest Diagnostics options would trade in the Bristol-Myers Squibb Co trading crowd.
